description: Source implementation of a memory allocator using mremap for arena management in a Linux environment, including functions for creating, destroying, growing, trimming, and allocating within memory arenas, as well as management of tags and statistics.

classes.name: fy_mremap_arena
classes.description: Represents a memory arena managed via mmap/mremap or malloc.

classes.name: fy_mremap_tag
classes.description: Represents a memory tag used for tracking allocations within an allocator tag.

classes.name: fy_mremap_allocator
classes.description: Main struct representing the mremap-based allocator, containing configuration, arena lists, and id management.

methods.name: struct:fy_mremap_arena * fy_mremap_arena_create(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt,size_t size)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new memory arena with specified size, uses mmap or malloc based on configuration.

methods.name: void fy_mremap_arena_destroy(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt,struct fy_mremap_arena * mran)
methods.description: Destroys and releases resources associated with a memory arena.

methods.name: int fy_mremap_arena_grow(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt,struct fy_mremap_arena * mran,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Grows an existing arena by reallocating or remapping memory, depending on arena type.

methods.name: int fy_mremap_arena_trim(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt,struct fy_mremap_arena * mran)
methods.description: Attempts to shrink an arena to reclaim memory.

methods.name: struct:fy_mremap_tag * fy_mremap_tag_from_tag(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,int tag)
methods.description: Retrieves the tag structure from the allocator given a tag ID.

methods.name: void fy_mremap_tag_cleanup(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt)
methods.description: Cleans up arenas associated with a specific tag, including active and full lists.

methods.name: void fy_mremap_tag_trim(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt)
methods.description: Trims the arenas of a tag to reduce memory usage.

methods.name: void fy_mremap_tag_reset(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt)
methods.description: Destroys all arenas associated with a tag, resetting its state.

methods.name: void fy_mremap_tag_setup(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt)
methods.description: Initializes a tag structure for a new allocation context.

methods.name: void * fy_mremap_tag_alloc(struct fy_mremap_allocator * mra,struct fy_mremap_tag * mrt,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Allocates memory within a tag's arena, creating new arenas if necessary.

methods.name: struct:fy_allocator * fy_mremap_create(const void * cfg)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new mremap allocator instance with configuration.

methods.name: void fy_mremap_destroy(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys an mremap allocator instance.

methods.name: void fy_mremap_dump(struct fy_allocator * a)
methods.description: Dumps current state of the allocator, including arenas and stats.

methods.name: const void * fy_mremap_store(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const void * data,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: Stores a data block into the allocator, returning a pointer to allocated memory.

methods.name: const void * fy_mremap_storev(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const struct iovec * iov,int iovcnt,size_t align)
methods.description: Stores multiple data buffers into the allocator in one operation.

methods.name: void fy_mremap_release(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,const void * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Releases allocated memory (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: void fy_mremap_release_tag(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Releases all resources associated with a specific tag.

methods.name: int fy_mremap_update_stats(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,struct fy_allocator_stats * stats)
methods.description: Updates statistics structure with current allocator info for a given tag.

methods.name: struct:fy_allocator_info * fy_mremap_get_info(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag)
methods.description: Provides detailed statistics and state info about the allocator and its tags.

methods.name: void * fy_mremap_alloc(struct fy_allocator * a,int tag,size_t size,size_t align)
methods.description: unavailable
